Subject: Quick engineer sync — one short slot to confirm (beta access)

Hi Emily / Sam,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning — appreciate the candid product constraints you shared. I wanted to follow up because we didn’t get the chance to lock a hands-on engineer sync and your account is enrolled in our limited beta that requires a short ops/deep-dive within the next 72 hours to preserve priority access.

Recap (very short):
- Primary blocker: inference latency at 2k tokens for your batch job
- What we’d show: live routing policy + quick KV-cache demo + suggested quantization profile
- Goal: leave with a simple mutual action plan and a recommended config to test in staging

Can we lock one of these 15–20m engineer slots? I purposely picked very short windows to respect your team’s calendar: 
- Wed 12/08 09:30–09:50 PT
- Wed 12/08 16:00–16:20 PT
- Thu 12/09 08:15–08:35 PT

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll try to match. If we don’t get this scheduled by Fri 12/10 we’ll need to release the beta entitlement (we can reapply but it will add 2–3 weeks).

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a short walkthrough deck to make the meeting super-focused.

Thanks — Vivek

--
